newsitem.title: CANADA: WCE canola falls on commercial, hedge selling.
newsitem.headline: WCE canola falls on commercial, hedge selling.

text.p: WCE canola ended down on commercial selling and hedges, traders said.

"XCan was selling at the close, there were late hedges. About 200 July $410 puts traded with bids in for another 300," a trader said. July WCE futures crush margin rose to -3.96 Friday from -5.22 Thursday. About 100 July-Aug spread at $1.20, 200 July-Nov $35.60. Volume was 2,998 lots, or 59,960 tonnes, with 181 hedges.
Japan bought 1,000-2,000 tonnes overnight, sources said.
July canola lost $2.90 to $403, November down $1.70 to $369.70.
July flax rose $0.40 to $330.50 on commercials, November down $1.60 to $315.30 on hedges. Volume was 180 lots.

RBC-DS bought July western barley rose $0.60 to $132.60, October up $0.30 to $133.90 as commercials and locals sold. July-Oct spread at $1, Alberta Wheat Pool sold 90 July-Dec $2.50 to Benson Quinn, a trader said. Volume was 500 lots.
July wheat lost $0.50 at $158.50, October fell $0.40 at $160.10 on late commercial hedges. July-Oct $1, July-Dec $1. Volume was 239 lots. Oats did not trade.
October feed pea contracts rose US$0.60 to US$184.40, December up US$0.40 to US$184.50 as Cargill bought. Volume 55.
(All prices in Canadian dollars/tonne except oats, peas).
